summary: Smoker Holler confirmed on Campspot: 33 full-hookup 30/50 A sites (24 back-in, 9 pull-through), $50 flat year-round (stored confirmed) + 3% park convenience fee; 3-night minimum only on holiday weekends and in October (not standing). Price gate: $50 base passes, and GSMNP gateway 8 km anyway. Google 4.1 (64).
flags: PRICE GATE: $50 base exactly at the gate; with the park's own 3% 'Convenience Fee' a night costs $51.50 before tax. Gateway passes regardless (gateways.py: Great Smoky Mountains NP 8 km). Google Maps 4.1 stars / 64 reviews (Campspot 4.4 / 33): a narrow price pass with mediocre reviews - reviewer call per the 'passes narrowly + under ~4.5' rule, though the gateway clears the price.
MINIMUM STAY: 3 nights on Memorial Day and July 4th weekends and throughout October (fall color); one night sells on every other date tried. Not a standing minimum.

LONG-STAY: Campspot's two RV types list all 33 sites as nightly sites (24 + 9 in Sept-Nov 2027). Only 13 of them showed for Dec 2026 - Jan 2027, so some sites are occupied over the winter; the rules speak of 'Tenants' and 'Landlord'. No monthly or seasonal product is advertised. Nightly in character.
